rows.grounds: compound of lalāṭa (forehead), varṇa (syllable), rāśi (mass), stha (situated)
numeral lakṣa in accusative singular neuter

items.question: What action follows after placing a hundred thousand in the forehead syllable mass?
premises: forehead syllable mass holds situated count
hundred thousand is the stated quantity
kṛtya marks the action to perform
items.inference: the verse directs performing the rite after the forehead syllable count is established
uncertainties: exact grammatical case and vocative force of sura+arcite remain unresolved
items.plain_english: Having situated a hundred thousand in the mass of syllables at the forehead, do the rite, O worshipped god.
